text: SPLR[p,q,n,nb] denotes the perpendicular component in the lightcone decomposition of the scalar product p \cdot q along the vectors n and nb. It corresponds to \((p \cdot q)_{\perp}\).
Overview, Pair, FVLN, FVLP, FVLR, SPLP, SPLN, MTLP, MTLN, MTLR.
StandardForm[SPLR[p, q, n, nb] // FCI] (*Pair[LightConePerpendicularComponent[Momentum[p], Momentum[n], Momentum[nb]], LightConePerpendicularComponent[Momentum[q], Momentum[n], Momentum[nb]]]*)
SPLR[p1 + p2, q1 + q2, n, nb] // FCI // ExpandScalarProduct
SPLR[p1 + p2 + n, q, n, nb] // FCI // ExpandScalarProduct
